name: EZ Bar Decline Lying Triceps Extension
steps: Lie on the decline bench with your feet secured and hold the EZ bar above your chest with a close overhand grip.
Angle your upper arms slightly back toward your head so your triceps stay under tension.
Bend your elbows to lower the EZ bar smoothly toward your forehead or just behind the crown of your head.
Extend your elbows to press the bar back up to the starting position without shifting your upper arms.
tips: Keep your elbows pointed upward and relatively close together rather than flaring wide.
Lower the bar slowly to keep full control around your head.
